summary: Iteration 11 — Multi-logbook / multi-user-type feature validated end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_logbooks.py (14 tests, all pass) covering registration (radioamateur/cibiste/swl + no_callsign SWL-FR-XXXX auto-generation + validation errors), login response shape (user_type, callsigns), QSO logbook filtering (POST + /grouped + /stats/total + list), and callsigns PUT (/auth/callsigns) with duplicate rejection. Frontend UI verified via Playwright: logbook selector shows 3 options (📡 Ham Radio / 🚛 CB / 🎧 SWL), switching Ham→CB shows 0 QSOs, switching back shows 7 callsigns, CB AddQSOModal exposes only FM/SSB/AM, SWL AddQSOModal hides rst_sent + qsl_sent and keeps rst_received + qsl_received, Ham modal shows 14 modes. Profile page exposes 3 callsign inputs (radio/cb/swl). SWL registration with 'no callsign' flow generates SWL-FR-XXXX and logs the user in.

minor.issue: Invalid logbook query is silently ignored (no filter applied → returns ALL QSOs across logbooks) instead of 400 or defaulting to radioamateur as the ?logbook param default suggests. Same for /qso and /qso/grouped. Low risk since UI only sends valid values, but the docstring/param default is misleading.

Does NOT accept or persist a 'logbook' field, so multipart ADIF imports always land in radioamateur (missing logbook key → mongo doc has no logbook → won't match /qso?logbook=… queries). Only the /qso/import/adif-text JSON endpoint supports logbook. Recommend adding a Form(...) logbook param to the multipart endpoint too, and setting logbook='radioamateur' default explicitly on the doc.

integration_issues.issue: After registering as SWL, activeLogbook defaults to 'radioamateur' (empty logbook) instead of the user's own type ('swl'). User has to manually switch to SWL to see their logbook. Suggest: on login/register, initialize activeLogbook from user.user_type when localStorage is empty.

action_items: (Minor) Default activeLogbook to user.user_type ('cb' → 'cb', 'swl' → 'swl', 'radioamateur' → 'radioamateur') on first login when no localStorage value exists, otherwise SWL/CB users see an empty Ham Radio logbook right after registration.
(Minor) /api/qso/import/adif multipart endpoint should accept a logbook form field and persist it on each doc; currently only /qso/import/adif-text supports per-logbook import.
(Minor) Consider rejecting or defaulting invalid ?logbook= values on the QSO list/grouped/stats endpoints instead of silently ignoring them.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1329 lines — split into modules (auth, qso, admin, wavelog, imports) per >700-line guideline.

In /api/auth/register: callsign uniqueness check treats empty string as a legitimate candidate. Because migrated users have empty strings in callsigns.cb/swl, the $or lookup on new-users still works only because the input callsign is enforced ≥2 chars. Still, defensive: skip empty values in the $or list.

get_current_user backfills callsigns dict from user['callsign'] only into 'radioamateur' key — for legacy CB or SWL users (pre-migration) this could mis-attribute. Migration script apparently already ran; fine, but consider using user_type when synthesizing the fallback.

If main agent addresses the SWL default-logbook UX suggestion, verify by registering a fresh SWL user and asserting Dashboard's logbook-selector value === 'swl' immediately after registration. Backend regression coverage now includes test_auth_no_cookies.py, test_password_reset.py, test_pwa_wavelog.py, test_requirements_cleanup.py, and the new test_logbooks.py — all pass against https://radio-memory.preview.emergentagent.com.
